records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Lantern Group set up
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Glad to have Lantern Group on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Your notification badge, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for flagging the notification bell badge that won't clear — that ticket is still open with our support team, and Tariq will follow up there with an update.

In the meantime, I don't want it to hold up the rest of your setup. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is the step that makes everything else click.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
